verdict.rationale: Retell documents its own per-agent data retention period. After the period expires, call and chat data (transcripts, recordings, logs) is automatically and permanently deleted, which directly covers retention control and scheduled deletion. The evidence does not show on-demand deletion of specific records or an account, nor API or CLI control of retention, so the deletion half of the story is only partly covered. Missing for 10: documented on-demand or manual deletion of individual calls, chats or account data; API or programmatic control of retention settings; independent or hands-on corroboration of the retention feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Retell allows you to configure a data retention period per agent. After the retention period expires, call and chat data associated with that agent is automatically and permanently deleted.
Configure per-agent data retention to automatically delete call and chat data — transcripts, recordings, and logs — after a set period for compliance.
